title: writetable
summary: Write a table to a delimited text file.

gpu_support.notes: Table data is serialized on the host. Automatically resident values gather transparently; explicit gpuArray input requires RunMat mode.

description: `writetable(T, filename)` writes table variables to a delimited text file.
behaviors: `"Delimiter"` controls the field separator and defaults to comma.
`"WriteVariableNames"` controls header emission and defaults to true.
Fields containing delimiters, quotes, or newlines are CSV-quoted.
Variables from all eight native integer classes are serialized with their exact decimal values.
A typed-integer `WriteVariableNames` value, explicit `gpuArray` input, and the bytes-written output are available in RunMat mode.
